patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ooma and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Ooma and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Ooma only if your buying job matches “SMB VoIP (Ooma Office) — Essentials from $19.95/user/mo monthly; Pro $24.95; Pro Plus $29.” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Ooma's shape. Workflow advantage: Ooma leans sales-calling; Zoom leans team-communication. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ooma and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ooma is SMB VoIP (Ooma Office) — Essentials from $19.95/user/mo monthly; Pro $24.95; Pro Plus $29.95 — no annual lock-in.; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: Ooma (solo, small-business) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ooma-leaning sales-calling vs Zoom-leaning team-communication.
- Researched limits: Ooma — SMS allotments are account-wide caps (e.g. Pro ~250/mo) — not per-user unlimited; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Ooma: SMS allotments are account-wide caps (e.g. Pro ~250/mo) — not per-user unlimited; Call queues, CRM and auto-dialer require Pro Plus; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Ooma is a poor fit when that limitation bites: SMS allotments are account-wide caps (e.g. Pro ~250/mo) — not per-user unlimited · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Ooma if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
